claims.value: Gemma 3 is a multimodal family of open models from Google supporting text and image input with text output. The 4B instruction-tuned variant uses 4 trillion tokens for training and supports 128K context, multilingual input in 140+ languages, and image analysis tasks.
claims.evidence: Gemma 3 models are multimodal, handling text and image input and generating text output
Total input context of 128K tokens for the 4B, 12B, and 27B sizes, and 32K tokens for the 1B size
